title: Harmonize surface scale and type rhythm across tokens
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Goal: Rationalize and publish a compact, semantic token set covering color palettes, typography scale, spacing/radius, and elevation/shadow so component styles (buttons, tables, charts) share a predictable surface rhythm. Deliverables: 1) semantic color palette (surface/neutral/interactive/feedback) with 7-step accessible swatches and token aliases for legacy usage; 2) a modular typography scale (base 16px, 4-step scale with defined line-height and letter-spacing); 3) spacing and corner radius primitives reduced to 4 base tokens with alias mapping; 4) 3 elevation levels with standardized shadow parameters and guidance for usage; 5) token export pipeline for CSS custom properties, JS/TS token module, and JSON for runtime; 6) migration guide and codemods for component library consumers.
comments: 2026-02-14 — Initial proposal uploaded to Confluence with mock token set. Requested feedback from frontend and platform teams.

2026-02-18 — Engineering (Sara Lee) flagged runtime token mapping concerns: need stable variable names for VPC/private deployments. Action: add an alias layer and generate canonical token map in build step.
2026-02-24 — Accessibility review (Omar Ruiz): contrast checks pass for primary/neutral foreground combinations but chart greens need tweaking at small sizes. Sent updated swatches and test matrix.
2026-03-02 — Design review: opted for a 4-step spacing scale (xs/s/m/l) based on baseline 8px grid to match runtime batching assumptions in UI (fewer unique paddings = better caching).
2026-03-05 — PM feedback (Jordan Park): include deprecation schedule for legacy tokens and automated codemods. Added codemod PR template and migration checklist.

2026-03-08 — Engineering review (Liam O'Connor): confirmed CSS custom properties and JS token bundle shape. Agreed on naming conventions: --rwd-surface-0..3, --rwd-elevation-1..3, --rwd-type-base/scale-1..4.
2026-03-09 — Figma file updated with new token styles and component overrides. Link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-design-tokens

2026-03-10 — PR opened for token exports and tokenized Button/Table components: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/512. Next: run codemod across examples and start staggered rollout to consuming apps.
implementation_notes:
- Keep legacy tokens available as aliases for two sprints; emit console warnings when legacy tokens used in dev builds.
- Export: tokens.json (canonical), tokens.css (CSS vars), tokens.js (named exports).
- Accessibility: run automated axe/contrast checks in CI for any visual changes.
- Charts: provide color ramp suggestions for 8/12-category palettes and ensure saturation adjustments for degraded display modes.
- Migration plan: (1) publish token package beta, (2) run codemod PRs against apps, (3) enable opt-in in Console feature flags, (4) flip default after two-week soak.
- Performance consideration: fewer unique spacing/radius values reduces stylesheet size and runtime style recalculation on mobile.
